data.main_content_0_1:
Local data storage is an application-level mechanism used to save measurement data, application records, and operational information directly to the local filesystem.

In embedded Linux applications, data generated by sensors, communication interfaces, and application processes can be stored in local files for future reference, monitoring, analysis, and troubleshooting.

This document explains how to implement file-based data storage using Python on Linux-based embedded systems. It covers file creation, data recording, timestamp management, data retrieval, storage organization, error handling, and backup procedures.

The implementation is designed to be adaptable across different embedded Linux platforms without depending on a specific processor, development board, or hardware architecture.
